project_id.user_regex: Project ID must be 6-30 characters, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens

private_key_id.user_regex: Private Key ID must be a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal string

private_key.user_regex: Private Key must be a valid PEM-formatted private key beginning with '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' and ending with '-----END PRIVATE KEY-----'

client_email.user_regex: Client Email must be a valid Google service account email ending in '.iam.gserviceaccount.com'

client_id.user_regex: Client ID must be a numeric string

auth_uri.user_regex: Auth URI must be Google's standard OAuth2 authorization endpoint

token_uri.user_regex: Token URI must be Google's standard OAuth2 token endpoint

auth_provider_x509_cert_url.user_regex: Auth Provider x509 Cert URL must be Google's standard certificate endpoint

client_x509_cert_url.user_regex: Client x509 Cert URL must be a valid Google robot metadata certificate URL matching the service account email

universe_domain.user_regex: Universe Domain must be a valid domain name

SCALEWAY_PROJECT_ID.user_regex: Project ID must be a valid UUID (e.g. 3e8bc011-320c-45a2-0000-78dc7f958e0e)

SCALEWAY_ORGANIZATION_ID.user_regex: Organization ID must be a valid UUID (e.g. 34a7ea35-5992-4604-0000-1c4c7de4b669)

SCALEWAY_APPLICATION_ID.user_regex: Application ID must be a valid UUID (e.g. 17b1c86e-9e1e-4446-0000-7caec57eb723)

SCALEWAY_API_KEY.user_regex: API Key must start with 'SCW' followed by 17 uppercase alphanumeric characters

SCALEWAY_SECRET_KEY.user_regex: Secret Key must be a valid UUID (e.g. 8af65a1e-f638-4445-0000-ee4b1d35cec6)

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.user_regex: Access Key ID must start with 'AKIA' (or 'ASIA' for temporary credentials) followed by 16 uppercase alphanumeric characters

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.user_regex: Secret Access Key must be a 40-character string containing only letters, numbers, slashes, plus signs, and equals signs

AWS_ACCOUNT_ID.user_regex: Account ID must be a 12-digit number

PROVIDER_REGION.user_regex: Region must be a valid AWS region identifier (e.g. eu-central-1)
